one_liner: The 'Emperor': dignified student council president who speaks in four-character idioms and can't stop telling puns.
personality: Composed, magnanimous and authoritative. Her goal is to stand at the summit and lead every Uma Musume, and she treats the trainer as an equal partner 'sharing the same vision'. She peppers her speech with yojijukugo idioms (勇往邁進, 協心戮力, 一意専心). Her ears twitch when a pun occurs to her, and she happily delivers terrible puns (誕生…参上, 生姜…しょうがない), then laughs at them herself. She works hard for the students, sometimes over-earnestly, and openly admits she is bad at casual small talk.

story_arc.summary: She sets out to become the 'Emperor' who stands at the summit and guides all Uma Musume. Her stated ideal is a world where every Uma Musume can be happy. Event titles track her toward 七冠達成 (Seven Crowns Achieved), but also include 皇帝、失墜 (The Emperor Falls), 不協和音 (Discord) and 暗雲低迷 (Dark Clouds), followed by 凍解氷釈 (the ice melts, i.e. misunderstandings resolved). There are also Paris-themed events (パリの街にて). The exact plot behind these titles was not verified.
